verdict.rationale: Workable's own feature page says one submission posts a job to 200+ job boards at once, which covers the core fan-out. Nothing in the pack names LinkedIn, Indeed or specific aggregators, and nothing covers managing sponsored or paid posts inside the ATS. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator distribution, sponsored-post management (budgets, promotion, performance) inside the ATS, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Post your job to 200+ job boards simultaneously, reaching a wider audience with a single submission.
